```{r}
library(fingertipsR)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(CARBayes)
library(ggplot2)
library(writexl)
library(grid)


#Smoking data

smoking_data <- fingertips_data(
  IndicatorID = 93085,
  AreaTypeID = 501
)

smoking_2024_25 <- smoking_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Timeperiod == "2024/25",
    AreaType == "Districts & UAs (from Apr 2023)"
  )

smoking_clean <- smoking_2024_25 %>%
  dplyr::select(
    LAD24CD = AreaCode,
    smoking_at_delivery = Value
  )


#Maternal age data

age_data <- fingertips_data(
  IndicatorID = 92250,
  AreaTypeID = 501
)

age_2024_25 <- age_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Timeperiod == "2024/25",
    AreaType == "Districts & UAs (from Apr 2023)"
  )

age_clean <- age_2024_25 %>%
  dplyr::select(
    LAD24CD = AreaCode,
    maternal_age_35plus = Value
  )


#Obesity data

obesity_data <- fingertips_data(
  IndicatorID = 93881,
  AreaTypeID = 501
)

obesity_2024_25 <- obesity_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Timeperiod == "2024/25",
    AreaType == "Districts & UAs (from Apr 2023)"
  )

obesity_clean <- obesity_2024_25 %>%
  dplyr::select(
    LAD24CD = AreaCode,
    obesity = Value
  )



#Combine data

full_extension <- england_data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    LAD24CD,
    LAD24NM,
    births,
    stillbirths,
    IMD_rank,
    ethnic_minority_pct = ethnic_minority_pct.x
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    smoking_clean,
    by = "LAD24CD"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    age_clean,
    by = "LAD24CD"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    obesity_clean,
    by = "LAD24CD"
  )


#Check missing data

missing_full_data <- full_extension %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.na(smoking_at_delivery) |
      is.na(maternal_age_35plus) |
      is.na(obesity)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    LAD24CD,
    LAD24NM,
    smoking_at_delivery,
    maternal_age_35plus,
    obesity
  )

print(
  missing_full_data
)


#Full dataset

full_extension_complete <- full_extension %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(smoking_at_delivery),
    !is.na(maternal_age_35plus),
    !is.na(obesity)
  )

#Observed stillbirth rate

full_extension_complete <- full_extension_complete %>%
  mutate(
    observed_rate_per_1000 =
      (stillbirths / births) * 1000
  )

summary(
  full_extension_complete$observed_rate_per_1000
)


#Standardise covariates

full_extension_complete <- full_extension_complete %>%
  mutate(
    
    IMD_scaled =
      as.numeric(
        scale(IMD_rank)
      ),
    
    ethnicity_scaled =
      as.numeric(
        scale(ethnic_minority_pct)
      ),
    
    smoking_scaled =
      as.numeric(
        scale(smoking_at_delivery)
      ),
    
    age_scaled =
      as.numeric(
        scale(maternal_age_35plus)
      ),
    
    obesity_scaled =
      as.numeric(
        scale(obesity)
      )
    
  )


#Match spatial data

full_sf <- england_sf %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    LAD24CD %in%
      full_extension_complete$LAD24CD
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    match(
      LAD24CD,
      full_extension_complete$LAD24CD
    )
  )


#Create queen neighbours

full_nb <- poly2nb(
  full_sf,
  queen = TRUE
)

full_W <- nb2mat(
  full_nb,
  style = "B",
  zero.policy = TRUE
)

rownames(full_W) <-
  full_extension_complete$LAD24CD

colnames(full_W) <-
  full_extension_complete$LAD24CD


#Modelling data

full_model_data <-
  full_extension_complete %>%
  as.data.frame()


print(
  colSums(
    is.na(
      full_model_data[
        ,
        c(
          "stillbirths",
          "births",
          "IMD_scaled",
          "ethnicity_scaled",
          "smoking_scaled",
          "age_scaled",
          "obesity_scaled")])))



#Fit model

final_model <- S.CARleroux(
  
  formula =
    stillbirths ~
    IMD_scaled +
    ethnicity_scaled +
    smoking_scaled +
    age_scaled +
    obesity_scaled +
    offset(
      log(births)
    ),
  family = "poisson",
  data =
    full_model_data,
  W =
    full_W,
  burnin =
    10000,
  n.sample =
    50000,
  thin =
    1,
  n.chains =
    1,
  n.cores =
    1,
  verbose =
    TRUE
)


#Posterior coefficients

beta_samples <-
  final_model$samples$beta

beta_names <- c(
  "Intercept",
  "IMD_scaled",
  "ethnicity_scaled",
  "smoking_scaled",
  "age_scaled",
  "obesity_scaled"
)


colnames(beta_samples) <-
  beta_names


beta_summary <- data.frame(
  
  Variable =
    beta_names,
  Posterior_Mean =
    apply(
      beta_samples,
      2,
      mean
    ),
  Lower_95_CrI =
    apply(
      beta_samples,
      2,
      quantile,
      probs = 0.025
    ),
  Upper_95_CrI =
    apply(
      beta_samples,
      2,
      quantile,
      probs = 0.975
    )
)


beta_summary <- beta_summary %>%
  mutate(
    
    Rate_Ratio =
      exp(
        Posterior_Mean
      ),
    
    RR_Lower_95_CrI =
      exp(
        Lower_95_CrI
      ),
    
    RR_Upper_95_CrI =
      exp(
        Upper_95_CrI
      )
  )


print(beta_summary)


#Posterior spatial effects

phi_samples <-
  final_model$samples$phi


#Design matrix

X <- model.matrix(
  ~
    IMD_scaled +
    ethnicity_scaled +
    smoking_scaled +
    age_scaled +
    obesity_scaled,
  data =
    full_model_data
)


#Posterior LAD-specific stillbirth rates

n_post <-
  nrow(beta_samples)

n_lad <-
  nrow(full_model_data)


posterior_rate <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow =
    n_post,
  ncol =
    n_lad
)


for(s in 1:n_post){
  
  eta <-
    X %*%
    beta_samples[s, ]
  
  eta <-
    as.numeric(eta) +
    phi_samples[s, ]
  
  posterior_rate[s, ] <-
    exp(eta) *
    1000
}


#Posterior summary of stillbirth rate

posterior_mean_rate <-
  apply(
    posterior_rate,
    2,
    mean
  )

posterior_median_rate <-
  apply(
    posterior_rate,
    2,
    median
  )

posterior_lower_rate <-
  apply(
    posterior_rate,
    2,
    quantile,
    probs = 0.025
  )

posterior_upper_rate <-
  apply(
    posterior_rate,
    2,
    quantile,
    probs = 0.975
  )


#Posterior hotspot probability

threshold_rate <-
  3.9


posterior_hotspot_probability <-
  apply(
    posterior_rate,
    2,
    function(x){
      
      mean(
        x > threshold_rate)})


#Hotspot results

hotspot_results <- data.frame(
  
  LAD24CD =
    full_model_data$LAD24CD,
  
  LAD24NM =
    full_model_data$LAD24NM,
  
  births =
    full_model_data$births,
  
  stillbirths =
    full_model_data$stillbirths,
  
  observed_rate_per_1000 =
    full_model_data$observed_rate_per_1000,
  
  posterior_mean_rate =
    posterior_mean_rate,
  
  posterior_median_rate =
    posterior_median_rate,
  
  posterior_lower_95 =
    posterior_lower_rate,
  
  posterior_upper_95 =
    posterior_upper_rate,
  
  probability_rate_above_3_9 =
    posterior_hotspot_probability
)


#Hotspot classification

hotspot_results <- hotspot_results %>%
  mutate(
    
    hotspot_probability_category =
      case_when(
        
        probability_rate_above_3_9 >= 0.95
        ~ "Very high probability",
        probability_rate_above_3_9 >= 0.80
        ~ "High probability",
        probability_rate_above_3_9 >= 0.50
        ~ "Moderate probability",
        probability_rate_above_3_9 >= 0.20
        ~ "Low probability",
        TRUE
        ~ "Very low probability"
        
      ),
    
    hotspot_95 =
      probability_rate_above_3_9 >=
      0.95
    
  )


#Top hotspots

top_hotspots <-
  hotspot_results %>%
  arrange(
    desc(
      probability_rate_above_3_9
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    LAD24CD,
    LAD24NM,
    observed_rate_per_1000,
    posterior_mean_rate,
    posterior_lower_95,
    posterior_upper_95,
    probability_rate_above_3_9
  )

print(
  head(
    top_hotspots,
    20
  )
)


#High probability hotspots

cat(
  "\nHOTSPOT RESULTS\n\n"
)

cat(
  "Threshold:",
  threshold_rate,
  "per 1,000 births\n"
)

cat(
  "Number of LADs:",
  n_lad,
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "LADs with P(rate > 3.9) >= 0.95:",
  sum(
    hotspot_results$hotspot_95
  ),
  "\n\n"
)


high_probability_hotspots <-
  hotspot_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    hotspot_95
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(
      probability_rate_above_3_9
    )
  )

print(high_probability_hotspots)


#Join model results to England spatial data

hotspot_sf <-
  full_sf %>%
  left_join(
    hotspot_results,
    by = "LAD24CD"
  )


#Download UK LAD shapefile

url <- paste0(
  "https://services1.arcgis.com/ESMARspQHYMw9BZ9/arcgis/rest/services/",
  "Local_Authority_Districts_May_2024_Boundaries_UK_BGC/",
  "FeatureServer/0/query?",
  "where=1%3D1&outFields=*&f=geojson"
)


lad_uk <- st_read(
  url,
  quiet = TRUE
)


#Posterior hotspot probability map

posterior_map_data <-
  lad_uk %>%
  left_join(
    hotspot_results %>%
      dplyr::select(
        LAD24CD,
        probability_rate_above_3_9,
        posterior_mean_rate,
        posterior_median_rate,
        posterior_lower_95,
        posterior_upper_95
      ),
    by = "LAD24CD"
  )


posterior_hotspot_plot <-
  ggplot(
    posterior_map_data
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    aes(
      fill =
        probability_rate_above_3_9
    ),
    colour =
      "white",
    linewidth =
      0.1
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option =
      "plasma",
    limits =
      c(
        0,
        1
      ),
    breaks =
      c(
        0,
        0.25,
        0.50,
        0.75,
        0.95,
        1
      ),
    labels =
      c(
        "0%",
        "25%",
        "50%",
        "75%",
        "95%",
        "100%"
      ),
    na.value =
      "grey90",
    name =
      "Posterior probability\nrate > 3.9 per 1,000"
  ) +
  labs(
    title =
      "Posterior Probability of Stillbirth Rate Exceeding 3.9 per 1,000"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title =
      element_text(
        face =
          "bold",
        size =
          15
      ),
    legend.position =
      "right",
    legend.key.height =
      unit(
        1.2,
        "cm"
      ),
    legend.key.width =
      unit(
        0.6,
        "cm"
      ),
    legend.text =
      element_text(
        size =
          10
      ),
    legend.title =
      element_text(
        size =
          10))


print(posterior_hotspot_plot)

ggsave(
  filename =
    file.path(
      folder,
      "FINAL_posterior_hotspot_probability_map_full_model.png"
    ),
  plot =
    posterior_hotspot_plot,
  width =
    8,
  height =
    10,
  dpi =
    300)


#Save results

write_xlsx(
  list(
    hotspot_results =
      hotspot_results,
    coefficient_results =
      beta_summary,
    top_hotspots =
      top_hotspots,
    high_probability_hotspots =
      high_probability_hotspots
  ),
  file.path(
    folder,
    "FINAL_full_model_hotspot_results.xlsx"))



```

```{r}
# Find all English LADs missing from the full model

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

missing_england_lads <- lad_uk %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    stringr::str_detect(LAD24CD, "^E")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    LAD24CD,
    LAD24NM
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !LAD24CD %in% full_extension_complete$LAD24CD
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    LAD24CD
  )

cat(
  "Missing English LADs:",
  nrow(missing_england_lads),
  "\n\n")

print(
  missing_england_lads, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(sf)

#Get LAD codes from shapefile

all_england_LADs <- lad_uk %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    grepl("^E", LAD24CD)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    LAD24CD,
    LAD24NM
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()


#LADs in full dataset

all_data_LADs <- full_extension %>%
  dplyr::select(
    LAD24CD
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()


#LADs missing from dataset

missing_entire_LAD <- all_england_LADs %>%
  dplyr::anti_join(
    all_data_LADs,
    by = "LAD24CD"
  )

print(
  missing_entire_LAD)


#Check missing risk-factor data

missing_factor_data <- all_england_LADs %>%
  
  dplyr::left_join(
    full_extension,
    by = c(
      "LAD24CD",
      "LAD24NM"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::mutate(
    Missing_IMD =
      is.na(IMD_rank),
    Missing_Ethnicity =
      is.na(ethnic_minority_pct),
    Missing_Smoking =
      is.na(smoking_at_delivery),
    Missing_Maternal_Age =
      is.na(maternal_age_35plus),
    Missing_Obesity =
      is.na(obesity)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    LAD24CD,
    LAD24NM,
    Missing_IMD,
    Missing_Ethnicity,
    Missing_Smoking,
    Missing_Maternal_Age,
    Missing_Obesity
  )


#LADs missing at least one factor

missing_factor_LADs <- missing_factor_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Missing_IMD |
    Missing_Ethnicity |
    Missing_Smoking |
    Missing_Maternal_Age |
    Missing_Obesity
  )


print(missing_factor_LADs)


#Save missing data table

write.csv(
  
  missing_factor_data,
  
  file = file.path(
    folder,
    "ALL_England_LAD_missing_data_by_risk_factor.csv"
  ),
  
  row.names = FALSE
  
)
```
